section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes Study 1, which evaluated an affect regulation model examining the association between body dissatisfaction and two measures of positive body image (body appreciation and body image flexibility) among 247 Black college-bound older adolescent females. The study used self-reported height and weight to calculate BMI and found that BMI was the strongest predictor of both positive body image measures, with body size discrepancy contributing additional variance.
